open_points.subject: start_and_recover_kernel step 3 / check_installed_instances
open_points.text: for one it also selects an instance for, a manifest record that cannot be read or fails a check of the record itself (A08 rule 5) stops the start naming it
open_points.question: Which exact A08 rule 5 checks run at startup, and over which capability entries, when this step receives no operation name or proposed ports needed by several of those checks?
options: Check only service-record structure and duplicate capability names
Validate every capability entry using a separately defined startup-validity subset
Do no manifest validation here beyond the header-collision check
open_points.default_guess: Check only service-level record structure, duplicate capability names and the selected instance facts needed for credential-header collision.

open_points.subject: grant_standing_approval target node
open_points.text: grants a node of the flow's active version (`capability:flows.active_flow_version`, the node read through `capability:flows.read_flow_version`) whose class is not `destructive`
open_points.question: What happens when the named node is a function node and therefore has no effect class or operation binding?
options: Refuse the grant because standing approvals apply only to operation nodes
Create an active grant that can never be used
Treat the missing effect class as `read` and create the grant
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the grant because a function node performs no service send for a standing approval to authorize.
